span.p:
After 5 consecutive failures, all queued
requests are rejected with an error.
The bot logs the failure and waits for
the next user message to retry.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The llm-server is managed externally
(PM2). If it dies, PM2 restarts it.
The client side only handles
temporary connection errors.
